# Grid Container and Items

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Grid Container and Items

You can turn any element into a grid by applying display: grid; to it.

Example

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="item-1"></div>
3    <div class="item-2"></div>
4    <div class="item-3"></div>
5<div>
```

```css
1.container {
2    display: grid;
3
4    height: 150px;
5}
6
7.item-1 { background-color: orange; }
8.item-2 { background-color: lightblue; }
9.item-3 { background-color: pink; }
```

Browser Output

![Grid Container and Items](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the element with the display: grid; rule is the grid container. The three <div> elements inside the grid container are called grid items.

Although there is no visual change yet, grid gives you access to different grid properties.

Let's explore some of these properties.
